mainEntity.name: My garage walls are open studs and look uneven — what should I do first?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your garage walls are bare studs, uneven, or missing framing around the garage door opening, the safest move is to have them inspected before insulation, drywall, or a conversion starts. A proper framing check confirms the wall is plumb, the load path is sound, and the openings are sized correctly for what comes next.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have the framing inspected before insulation or drywall. Uneven or incomplete wall framing can cause problems with door openings, wall straightness, and later finishes.
